findings.title: The two-record 8-to-9 adoption lacks an interruption-safe transaction and recovery contract
findings.reproduction: At exact packet commit a1c76d12c5752ad12d63e192adf6cd46b5553772, inspect lifecycle.canonicalPaths, lifecycle.commands, lifecycle.adoption, verificationObligations, and the v2 runtime schema. The packet requires adoption to update planning/backlog.yaml and planning/governance-control-recovery/GCR-0002.B00.state.json, but defines no canonical transaction manifest or durable successor paths, no transaction schema/runtime record, no recovery command or automatic recovery rule, no Windows write-through/fsync requirement, and no child-process abrupt-termination matrix. Running `rg -n -i "transaction|journal|write-through|fsync|abrupt|crash|interruption|split.*state" planning/governance-control-recovery/GCR-0002.packet.json planning/governance-control-recovery/GCR-0002.md planning/governance-control-recovery/governance-control-recovery-request.v2.schema.json planning/governance-control-recovery/governance-control-recovery-runtime.v2.schema.json planning/governance-control-recovery/GCR-0002-review.html` returns no match. The only existing transaction schema, planning/governance-control-recovery/governance-control-recovery-transaction.schema.json, and tools/gcrctl.py transaction constants are identity/path-bound to GCR-0001 and cannot service GCR-0002 unchanged. GCR-0001.B00.review-R01.json already reproduced this exact class of defect by terminating a child after the first of two replacements, leaving successor backlog bytes beside predecessor GCR state; current GCR-0002 obligations cover ordinary adverse/stale/concurrent no-write paths but do not require that process-death boundary. Two independent canonical files cannot be made interruption-atomic merely by requiring a later exact two-path Git commit, so the current packet does not decision-completely establish acceptance criterion 5 or a safe rollback boundary.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant inert packet that canonically specifies and authorizes a GCR-0002-bound write-ahead transaction/recovery protocol: exact manifest, lock, durable successor, cleanup, and schema/runtime identities; raw and canonical-content hash/CAS bindings to the approved state, adoption evidence commit, active hold, trigger witness, predecessor revision 8, and successor revision 9; Windows replace-existing/write-through and required file/directory flush semantics; and an explicit idempotent recover command or equally explicit automatic recovery transition. Require all current and supported older readers to fail closed on every prepared, partial, marker-missing, substituted, stale, dirty-workspace, or split backlog/state combination until deterministic recovery yields either the exact predecessor pair or exact successor pair. Add child-process abrupt-termination tests at every preparation, publication, replacement, validation, and cleanup boundary, plus stale/concurrent and transaction-artifact workspace denials, while retaining the direct-child exact two-path finalization and separate S02 approval gate. Preserve this R01 ledger append-only and bind the remediation in a fresh R02 packet review.

verified: The exact packet commit is a1c76d12c5752ad12d63e192adf6cd46b5553772 on codex/w1-windows-local-runtime with direct parent c80efb865a37b78df6f4a59b9d14c32c7b840abe. Its inert delta is exactly six added paths: the proposal, authority manifest, packet, static review page, request-v2 schema, and runtime-v2 schema. It changes no controller, backlog, canonical state, approval, supplement, amendment, task, gate, product, or generated-view bytes.

The packet validates with zero Draft 2020-12 errors against governance-control-recovery-request.v2.schema.json; the runtime v2 schema passes metaschema validation. The packet SHA-256 is 89cf39684d727aaa923aeab458f2a31f1b6dd41a552595555780c49f92a5d1b2, and every declared proposal/schema/manifest/review-page hash matches current bytes.

All eleven path/hash/commit references in GCR-0002.authority.json reproduce exact current bytes and exact immutable Git blobs at their declared commits, and every declared commit plus the S01 candidate/reviewed-state, W1.A04 historical candidate, and discovery commit is ancestral to the packet commit.

The authority-manifest stopped boundary is exact: backlog SHA-256 0b3d22f30d3a024e37b6c7b9b07d48f3a0b96dd2fc6c1968809a21d35a2977e7; control revision and minimum tool revision 8; exactly one ACTIVE HOLD-W1-GRR-0002; approved GRR-0002.B00 and GRR-0002.S01/B01; W1 PAUSED at wave scope; W1.A04 absent; CAP-02.S04.T03 BLOCKED; and G1 PENDING.

The revision-8 reader gap is reproducible without mutation: tools/taskctl.py sets CONTROL_TOOL_REVISION=8; planning/backlog.schema.json rejects revision/minimum 9; the v2 supplement schema rejects predecessor 8 and successor 9; recoveryctl recognizes only v1/v2 supplement schemas and rejects a successor above the tool revision. A pure schema probe produced exactly both v2 transition ceiling errors and both backlog revision-9 errors.

The trigger witness is a regular nonsymlink file, is unstaged and untracked, is the sole untracked path, and has exact SHA-256 4a9d944ff95972b449b617bc384306c7023e79d31d6b427e6b6f4678cd58b22c. GCR-0001 packet/review/state and recoveryctl bind it as atomic-failure-trigger-only with executionAuthority false and deny its use as a transition artifact or W1.A04 authority. GCR-0002 preserves that immutable conflict and defers the committed byte-identical snapshot behavior entirely to separately reviewed and approved S02/B02.

The root lifecycle is otherwise non-circular and narrowly separated: an independently APPROVED packet-review ledger must be committed before exclusive repository-owner approval creation; that tracked-clean approval-introduction commit becomes the sole strict-descendant B00 base; live control remains 8 through independent B00 review; and only an approved direct-child adoption may record 8-to-9. Approval, B00 review, adoption, S02 packet review, S02 human approval, B02, W1.A04, T03, hold release, W1 resume, G1, main integration, and remote push remain distinct gates.

The exact historic W1.A04 bootstrap-submit command was replayed in a disposable real-Git clone with the exact trigger witness. It failed with `Amendment bootstrap implementation commit must equal current HEAD`, left backlog bytes and workspace status unchanged, and the clone and bundle were removed.

Current taskctl backlog validation, approved GRR-0002 validation, approved S01 validation, adopted GCR-0001 validation, approved ECR-0003 validation, generated backlog views, the 150-page review site, governed Python quality over 121 files, 22 taskctl schema tests, packet HTML parsing, exact six-path scope, and Git diff hygiene all pass.

The remaining HIGH finding is limited to the packet's missing interruption-safe two-file adoption/recovery contract. Until a strict-descendant packet closes it through a fresh independent review, exact human approval and GCR-0002.B00 execution are unavailable.
